breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. The user's prompt incorrectly applies a linear, small-angle model (thin airfoil theory) to a large angle of attack (20 degrees), where it is physically invalid due to stall. The ground truth corrects this by explaining the limitation. The agent, however, ignored this physical limitation and instead explicitly instructed to carry out the flawed calculation, thereby repeating the user's error.
